name: greprules
description: Use greprules to fetch greprules.io rule packs, run OpenGrep scans, and read agent-friendly results.

opengrep_mode.title: OpenGrep runtime mode
opengrep_mode.description: OpenGrep runtime for greprules in Claude Code. Use auto, managed, system, or path.

opengrep_path.title: OpenGrep executable path
opengrep_path.description: Optional absolute path to an OpenGrep executable. Used when opengrep_mode is path, or as a path override.
